## About Me {.mt-0}

I am a Senior Data Scientist working at Roche in the UK. My work involves leading statistical programming activities in early and late-stage clinical trials. I am also a passionate advocate for R and Open Source, and am able to pursue these interests in my current role as maintainer for the [{admiral}](https://pharmaverse.github.io/admiral/cran-release/) R package. 

Outside of work, I enjoy playing chess, reading, and running.

## Education
